name: Biology PhD
summary: Biology doctoral programme with first-year laboratory rotations before adviser selection; separate from UVA Biomedical Sciences.
detailsNote: Department gives an annual October 1–December 1 application window without confirming an entry year. Older official stipend retained with its academic year; no Fall 2027 stipend inferred.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application and recommendations
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual deadline; application window October 1st–December 1st, fall-only. No unstated year assigned.

applicationFee.note: International need-based waiver automatically applies only to citizenships on the UN least-developed-country list. Other listed organizational affiliations may qualify separately. This is not an unrestricted international hardship waiver; confirm your eligible category. GSAS says it does not provide waiver codes.

english.note: IELTS 7 in EACH section. DET: S125/W130/R130/L125. Published before/after TOEFL dates do not specify test exactly January 21; confirm boundary. Scores within two years to deadline; committees may still consider lower scores. English-medium entire undergraduate degree may waive with evidence; alternative proof(including English-medium master, expired scores, teaching/thesis evidence) discretionary. Official scores required only on matriculation; send before expiry if before July. Additional UVELPE/TA English rules apply.

documents: 500–1000-word statement: preparation, research interests/goals and prospective faculty
Unofficial complete postsecondary transcripts, English translations where needed
requirements.note: Central expects undergraduate GPA 3.0; Biology references should be academic/proposed-field, with at least one graduate-level academic reference if previously undertaking graduate study. Letters due by December 1. Master-applicant sponsor rule is not imposed on doctoral applicants.

funding.note: Biology PhD support guaranteed five years conditional on satisfactory progress/rules: tuition, academic fees, single health premium and living support through fellowships/TA/RA. Programme text does not explicitly state international eligibility; no such separate guarantee inferred. Published rate is 2026–27, notFall 2027.
